002

values

Why Choose Us?
--------------

We build AI-powered automation systems that eliminate manual work, reduce costs, and multiply your business performance.

01

Built Around Your Business

Every solution is scoped and built specifically for the way you operate. No templates. No shortcuts.

02

One Team for Everything

CRM, AI, automation, web, apps, and branding, all under one roof. One point of contact. Full accountability.

03

We Stay After Delivery

We don't hand over and disappear. Every solution comes with ongoing support from the team that built it.

003

Capabilities

Our Services
------------

AI Workflow Automation. Automate repetitive tasks across departments using intelligent triggers and decision logic. We connect your tools and eliminate the manual work, from lead capture to internal workflows to reporting.

Workflow mapping

Real-time system integration.

Validated output

![](images/Cap1.png)

AI Voice Agents & Chatbots. Intelligent agents that handle inbound and outbound calls, qualify leads, respond to messages, and book appointments. 24 hours a day, across phone, WhatsApp, SMS, and web.

![](images/Cap2.png)

E-Commerce. Shopify and WordPress stores built end-to-end design, products, payments, shipping, and automation fully configured.

![](images/Cap3.png)

CRM & Sales Automation. Pipeline automation, AI lead scoring, follow-ups, predictive insights.

![](images/Cap4.png)

Website & Web Application Development. Custom websites and web applications built on modern technology — fast, secure, and built to convert.

![](images/Cap5.png)

Mobile App Development. IOS and Android applications built cross-platform with Flutter, for client-facing products and internal business tools.

![](images/flutter_new.png)

Branding. Complete visual identity systems. Logo, brand guidelines, and all digital and print assets your business needs to look the part.

004

process

How We Work
-----------

A proven process designed to transform complex workflows into scalable systems, efficiently and strategically.

01

Discovery & Audit

We listen first. One honest conversation about your business, what's working, what isn't, and where technology can make a real difference.

Scoping & Planning

A clear, specific plan. What we'll build, how long it takes, and what the outcome looks like. No vague proposals. No surprises.

02

03

Build & Integration

Our team handles everything, design, development, configuration, and integration with your existing tools.

Testing & Optimization

We test every system thoroughly before handover, real scenarios, edge cases, and full QA to make sure everything works exactly as intended.

04

05

Delivery & Ongoing Support

Full handover with documentation and training where needed. Then we stay involved, maintaining, updating, and improving what we built.

010

FAQs

Common Questions
----------------

1

What industries do you work with?

We work with businesses across all industries, real estate, healthcare, retail, education, logistics, hospitality, and professional services. If there's a technology problem in your business, there's a good chance we've solved one like it before.

2

Do you work with international clients?

Yes. We actively serve clients in the US, UK, Middle East, and India. Our primary focus is the US market.

3

How long does a project take?

It depends on the scope. A basic automation workflow can be live in 2–3 days. A full CRM build takes 1–2 weeks. A custom web or mobile application takes 4–12 weeks. We always give you a clear timeline before we start.

4

Do you offer ongoing support after delivery?

Yes. Every project includes a post-launch support period. We also offer monthly retainers for ongoing management, maintenance, and continued development.

5

How do I get started?

Book a free 30-minute discovery session. We'll listen to what your business needs and tell you honestly what we'd recommend, no sales pitch, no pressure.

Have any other questions?

// ── CONFIG ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── const APPS\_SCRIPT\_URL = 'https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbw-8BHWAhfYm\_nGITW5FUSN0EmeRgpvYh7O81y-qbTWR-p7YAc9V-gDlb7Ga8xnSNds0w/exec'; const BISSOLVE\_TIMEZONE = 'Asia/Dubai'; // Bissolve's local timezone const USER\_TIMEZONE = Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone; // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── // 60-min slots, Mon–Fri 9am–6pm in BISSOLVE\_TIMEZONE const TIME\_SLOTS = \[ '9:00 AM', '10:00 AM', '11:00 AM', '12:00 PM', '1:00 PM', '2:00 PM', '3:00 PM', '4:00 PM', '5:00 PM' \]; let selectedDate = null; let selectedTime = null; let selectedTimeDisplay = null; let bookedSlots = \[\]; let currentYear, currentMonth; const today = new Date(); today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0); currentYear = today.getFullYear(); currentMonth = today.getMonth(); // ── Timezone helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── function getTzOffsetMs(tz, utcDate) { const fmt = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { timeZone: tz, year: 'numeric', month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit', hour12: false }); const parts = fmt.formatToParts(utcDate); const p = {}; parts.forEach(x => { if (x.type !== 'literal') p\[x.type\] = parseInt(x.value); }); if (p.hour === 24) p.hour = 0; const localAsUTC = Date.UTC(p.year, p.month - 1, p.day, p.hour, p.minute, p.second); return localAsUTC - utcDate.getTime(); } function convertSlotToUserTz(date, slotStr) { const match = slotStr.match(/(\\d+):(\\d+)\\s\*(AM|PM)/i); if (!match) return slotStr; let h = parseInt(match\[1\]); const m = parseInt(match\[2\]); const period = match\[3\].toUpperCase(); if (period === 'PM' && h !== 12) h += 12; if (period === 'AM' && h === 12) h = 0; const fakeUTC = new Date(Date.UTC(date.getFullYear(), date.getMonth(), date.getDate(), h, m, 0)); const bizOffsetMs = getTzOffsetMs(BISSOLVE\_TIMEZONE, fakeUTC); const trueUTC = new Date(fakeUTC.getTime() - bizOffsetMs); return trueUTC.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', { timeZone: USER\_TIMEZONE, hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit', hour12: true }); } function tzLabel(tz) { try { const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { timeZone: tz, timeZoneName: 'short' }).formatToParts(new Date()); const abbr = parts.find(p => p.type === 'timeZoneName')?.value || ''; return \`${tz.replace(/\_/g, ' ')} (${abbr})\`; } catch { return tz; } } // ── Fetch booked slots from Apps Script ─────────────────────────────────── function dateKey(date) { return \`${date.getFullYear()}-${String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}\`; } async function fetchBookedSlots(date) { try { const url = \`${APPS\_SCRIPT\_URL}?action=getBookedSlots&date=${dateKey(date)}\`; const res = await fetch(url, { mode: 'cors', redirect: 'follow' }); if (!res.ok) throw new Error(\`HTTP ${res.status}\`); const data = await res.json(); return Array.isArray(data.bookedSlots) ? data.bookedSlots.map(s => String(s).trim()) : \[\]; } catch (e) { console.warn('Could not fetch booked slots:', e.message); return \[\]; } } // ── Calendar ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── const MONTHS = \['January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June', 'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December'\]; const DAYS = \['Sun', 'Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat'\]; function renderCalendar() { document.getElementById('cal-month-label').textContent = \`${MONTHS\[currentMonth\]} ${currentYear}\`; const grid = document.getElementById('cal-grid'); grid.innerHTML = ''; DAYS.forEach(d => { const el = document.createElement('div'); el.className = 'cal-day-label'; el.textContent = d; grid.appendChild(el); }); const firstDay = new Date(currentYear, currentMonth, 1).getDay(); const daysInMonth = new Date(currentYear, currentMonth + 1, 0).getDate(); for (let i = 0; i < firstDay; i++) { const el = document.createElement('div'); el.className = 'cal-day empty'; grid.appendChild(el); } // Cutoff: require 24h advance booking const cutoff = new Date(Date.now() + 24 \* 60 \* 60 \* 1000); for (let d = 1; d <= daysInMonth; d++) { const el = document.createElement('div'); const date = new Date(currentYear, currentMonth, d); const dow = date.getDay(); // A day is "available" if it's a weekday AND at least one slot is after cutoff const lastSlotStr = TIME\_SLOTS\[TIME\_SLOTS.length - 1\]; const lastSlotMatch = lastSlotStr.match(/(\\d+):(\\d+)\\s\*(AM|PM)/i); let lh = parseInt(lastSlotMatch\[1\]); if (lastSlotMatch\[3\].toUpperCase() === 'PM' && lh !== 12) lh += 12; const lastSlotTime = new Date(date); lastSlotTime.setHours(lh, 0, 0, 0); const isPast = lastSlotTime <= cutoff; const isWeekend = dow === 0 || dow === 6; el.className = 'cal-day'; el.textContent = d; if (isPast || isWeekend) { el.classList.add('disabled'); } else { if (date.getTime() === today.getTime()) el.classList.add('today'); if (selectedDate && date.getTime() === selectedDate.getTime()) el.classList.add('selected'); el.addEventListener('click', () => selectDate(date)); } grid.appendChild(el); } } async function selectDate(date) { selectedDate = date; selectedTime = null; selectedTimeDisplay = null; bookedSlots = \[\]; renderCalendar(); renderTimeSlotsLoading(); updateSummary(); bookedSlots = await fetchBookedSlots(date); renderTimeSlots(); } // ── Time slots ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── function renderTimeSlotsLoading() { document.getElementById('time-side-date').textContent = selectedDate.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { weekday: 'long', month: 'long', day: 'numeric' }); document.getElementById('time-tz-badge').style.display = 'none'; document.getElementById('time-grid').innerHTML = \`<div class="time-loading"><div class="time-loading-dot"></div><div class="time-loading-dot"></div><div class="time-loading-dot"></div></div>\`; } function renderTimeSlots() { const grid = document.getElementById('time-grid'); const dateEl = document.getElementById('time-side-date'); const tzBadge = document.getElementById('time-tz-badge'); if (!selectedDate) { dateEl.textContent = 'Select a date first'; tzBadge.style.display = 'none'; grid.innerHTML = '<div class="time-empty">← Pick a date to see slots</div>'; return; } dateEl.textContent = selectedDate.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { weekday: 'long', month: 'long', day: 'numeric' }); grid.innerHTML = ''; if (USER\_TIMEZONE !== BISSOLVE\_TIMEZONE) { tzBadge.innerHTML = \` <svg width="12" height="12" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 20 20"><circle cx="10" cy="10" r="8" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"/><path d="M10 6v4l2.5 2.5" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg> Times shown in: <strong style="color:rgba(255,255,255,.55);margin-left:.2rem;">${tzLabel(USER\_TIMEZONE)}</strong>\`; tzBadge.style.display = 'flex'; } else { tzBadge.style.display = 'none'; } const cutoff = new Date(Date.now() + 24 \* 60 \* 60 \* 1000); TIME\_SLOTS.forEach(slot => { // Check if slot is past cutoff const match = slot.match(/(\\d+):(\\d+)\\s\*(AM|PM)/i); let h = parseInt(match\[1\]), m = parseInt(match\[2\]); if (match\[3\].toUpperCase() === 'PM' && h !== 12) h += 12; if (match\[3\].toUpperCase() === 'AM' && h === 12) h = 0; const slotTime = new Date(selectedDate); slotTime.setHours(h, m, 0, 0); if (slotTime <= cutoff) return; // skip past/too-soon slots const isBooked = bookedSlots.includes(slot); const displayTime = convertSlotToUserTz(selectedDate, slot); const el = document.createElement('button'); el.type = 'button'; el.className = 'time-slot' + (slot === selectedTime ? ' selected' : '') + (isBooked ? ' booked' : ''); el.textContent = displayTime; el.disabled = isBooked; el.title = isBooked ? 'Already booked' : ''; if (!isBooked) { el.addEventListener('click', () => { selectedTime = slot; selectedTimeDisplay = displayTime; renderTimeSlots(); updateSummary(); }); } grid.appendChild(el); }); if (!grid.querySelector('.time-slot')) { grid.innerHTML = '<div class="time-empty">No slots available for this day</div>'; } } // ── Summary ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── function updateSummary() { const summary = document.getElementById('step1-summary'); const btn = document.getElementById('btn-next-1'); if (selectedDate && selectedTime) { const d = selectedDate.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { weekday: 'short', month: 'short', day: 'numeric' }); summary.innerHTML = \`<strong>${d} at ${selectedTimeDisplay || selectedTime}</strong>\`; btn.disabled = false; } else if (selectedDate) { summary.textContent = 'Now pick a time →'; btn.disabled = true; } else { summary.textContent = 'No date or time selected yet'; btn.disabled = true; } } // ── Month nav ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── document.getElementById('prev-month').addEventListener('click', () => { const prev = new Date(currentYear, currentMonth - 1, 1); const now = new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), 1); if (prev >= now) { currentMonth--; if (currentMonth < 0) { currentMonth = 11; currentYear--; } } renderCalendar(); }); document.getElementById('next-month').addEventListener('click', () => { currentMonth++; if (currentMonth > 11) { currentMonth = 0; currentYear++; } renderCalendar(); }); // ── Step navigation ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── function goToStep(n) { document.querySelectorAll('.step-panel').forEach((p, i) => p.classList.toggle('active', i + 1 === n)); for (let i = 1; i <= 3; i++) { const ind = document.getElementById(\`step-ind-${i}\`); ind.classList.remove('active', 'done'); if (i < n) ind.classList.add('done'); if (i === n) ind.classList.add('active'); } window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' }); } document.getElementById('btn-next-1').addEventListener('click', () => { if (!selectedDate || !selectedTime) return; const d = selectedDate.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { weekday: 'long', month: 'long', day: 'numeric' }); document.getElementById('form-summary-datetime').textContent = \`${d} · ${selectedTimeDisplay || selectedTime}\`; goToStep(2); }); document.getElementById('btn-back-1').addEventListener('click', () => goToStep(1)); // ── Form submit ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── document.getElementById('booking-form').addEventListener('submit', async (e) => { e.preventDefault(); const btn = document.getElementById('btn-submit'); btn.classList.add('loading'); btn.disabled = true; const form = e.target; const payload = { type: 'booking', firstName: form.firstName.value.trim(), lastName: form.lastName.value.trim(), email: form.email.value.trim(), phone: form.phone.value.trim(), service: form.service.value, message: form.message.value.trim(), date: selectedDate.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { weekday: 'long', year: 'numeric', month: 'long', day: 'numeric' }), dateKey: dateKey(selectedDate), time: selectedTime, userTime: selectedTimeDisplay || selectedTime, userTimezone: USER\_TIMEZONE, page: window.location.href, }; try { await fetch(APPS\_SCRIPT\_URL, { method: 'POST', mode: 'no-cors', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(payload), }); const d = selectedDate.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { weekday: 'long', month: 'long', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' }); document.getElementById('confirm-datetime').textContent = \`${d} · ${selectedTimeDisplay || selectedTime}\`; document.getElementById('confirm-name').textContent = \`${payload.firstName} ${payload.lastName}\`; document.getElementById('confirm-email').textContent = payload.email; gtag && gtag('event', 'booking\_submitted', { service: payload.service }); goToStep(3); } catch (err) { alert('Something went wrong. Please try again or email us directly.'); btn.classList.remove('loading'); btn.disabled = false; } }); // Init renderCalendar(); renderTimeSlots(); updateSummary();
